test_title: PYST 26: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 2 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

By whom have the problems been solved?
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Who has solved the problems?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The above-given sentence is in the **passive voice.**
 
• We need to change it into **active voice**.
 
• We need to follow the given steps for converting the given sentence into active voice:-
 
• In sentences containing** 'who',** the passive starts with **'by whom'.**The following structure is followed:-
 
 
• Passive Voice - By whom + helping verb + Object + V3?
 
• Active Voice - Who + V1 + Object?
 
 
 
• The given sentence is in **present perfect tense.**
 
• **'have been solved' **changes to** 'has solved'.**
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

**Therefore, the correct active voice is** ​*Who has solved the problems?*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When we convert **active voice to passive voice,** three things need to be kept in mind:-

 
 
• Change **object **into **subject**.
 
• Change **subject **into **object**.
 
• Always use the **third form of the verb** in the passive voice.
 
• Use **'by'** before the new object. (there are some exceptions to this rule too)
